en.title: O
en.summary: The letter O is the fifteenth letter of the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: Letter sound
paragraphs: The letter name is the sound /o/, that is a pure full vowel. Its main sound is heard in the word (om) /om/, which means man or human. This Romanian letter has two sounds altogether.

sections.title: Pronunciation guide
paragraphs: For the full vowel, pull your tongue back and round your lips into an open circle. Let your vocal cords vibrate steadily. For the gliding sound, round your lips tightly and slide quickly into the next vowel. Place your hand on your throat to feel the strong vibration.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: In most positions, the letter makes the sound /o/, that is a pure full vowel. You can hear this sound in (copil) /koˈpil/. Before another vowel, it turns into a quick gliding sound /o̯/, that is a short semivowel. You can hear this glide in (soare) /ˈso̯a.re/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: English speakers often turn this vowel into a diphthong, like the sound in boat or go. Keep your lips and jaw completely still until the sound finishes. Do not add a glide at the end.
